versions.changelog:
Initial release of smart-search: a flexible, multi-engine search skill with auto language detection, fallback, and integrated result extraction.

- Integrates DDGS local library for structured, high-quality search (brave/bing/yandex/yahoo backends).
- Automatically detects query language and routes to optimal search engine (Chinese→bing, English→brave).
- Auto-fallback: seamlessly switches engines on failure; includes web_fetch downgrade options.
- One-step search and content extraction (markdown/fulltext) with script/API usage.
- Supports advanced features: timeout protection, URL-only output, batch search, result type selection (text/news/images/videos/books).
- Includes expert usage tips, best engine combinations, and troubleshooting guidance.
